item.description:
Changed

  • The app is now Chora. A new icon, and the Chora name everywhere you see it: Finder, the menu bar, Settings, the welcome screens and the permission prompts. Your settings, clipboard history and shelf carry over, and updates keep coming as before. An existing copy keeps its old file name until you rename it to Chora in Applications.
  • Updates install on their own. New versions now download in the background and install when you quit, without asking first. Turn this off with Automatically download updates in Settings.
